objective: Fix the unresponsive final Advertise submit button inside Profile → Advertise and complete the existing self-service paid advertisement workflow through authenticated System Admin review, manual payment verification and content approval, without disturbing existing sponsor ads or payment records.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub Main Advertise entry patch bd0acf0b7f783fd0aa9d9bfc663e6dc35c127faf is live on Android V28 runtime 1.3.2 and Expo web wmxsz8136r. Advertise final submit form uses Alert.alert-only validation, silently returns on missing auth, and its button sits after a long ScrollView beneath phone nav/keyboard. Production paid campaigns currently contain 2 pending rows with expired initial 30-day dates and zero new submissions over the last 24 hours. Admin Sponsors & Ads only reads app_sponsors, not buklod_paid_ad_campaigns, so self-service campaigns are invisible in admin review. DB has RLS account-isolated pending-only inserts and admin read/write, but private paid-ad-payment bucket had NO admin SELECT policy. Dry-run SQL migration/test executed in a ROLLBACK scope and passed; no production data mutated.
chosenApproach: Keep the existing advertiser form and payment pipeline. Make the final Submit Advertisement for Review a persistent keyboard-safe footer; show inline validation and submission results, block duplicate taps and require live DB prices. Extend the existing protected admin Sponsors & Ads screen with a paid campaign review section; add a guard-locked admin-only RPC for explicit separate payment verification, creative approval/rejection, pause/resume, and approval-time 30-day schedule reset. Grant read-only signed URL access to private payment evidence only to active system admins. Preserve ad price quote snapshot across administrative status changes.
selectionRationale: Entry shortcut OTA was published successfully, but it did not alter the separate final submit button. The admin screen looked only at the legacy app_sponsors table, so even successful self-service submissions were not reviewable. Current RLS already protects pending insert and existing live ads; a small admin bridge and feedback fix avoids replacing the monetization stack.
alternativeApproaches: Auto-approve and mark paid immediately on submit: rejected due to financial fraud and policy risks.
Publish a second ad backend or migrate existing app_sponsors rows: rejected because both existing tables have distinct purposes.
Use Alert.alert as sole validation/error feedback: rejected as it can silently fail on web and behind the keyboard.
Open payment proof as a public URL or give all authenticated members SELECT permission: rejected, payment data must remain private.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Profile → Advertise entry and previous live OTA untouched until new verified release.
Paid campaign insert remains restricted to owner, status pending and payment pending; never auto-charged or auto-approved.
Private payment screenshots remain private; signed proof access is admin-only and short-lived.
Legacy app_sponsors create/approve/pause/reject flow preserved in the same admin screen.
Real paid advertisements require explicit verified payment and separate creative approval before RLS live feed can read them.
Expiry does not begin at submission; admin approval starts 30 days, guarded server-side.
No member/account data, existing submitted campaigns, paid financial ledger or source secrets edited by this patch.
acceptanceChecks: Profile Advertise final CTA remains clickable after scrolling or keyboard, with immediate visible validation when fields, auth, media or rate are missing.
Successful submission creates one pending-only row in buklod_paid_ad_campaigns and shows persistent Pending Admin Review confirmation.
Admin Sponsors & Ads shows self-service campaigns while retaining legacy sponsor tools.
Admin can safely preview creative, view private signed payment proof, verify external payment separately, approve/reject content, pause/resume only if eligible.
Unauthorized users and anonymous calls cannot use payment/approval RPC; no unpaid campaign can be approved; 30-day dates reset on approval.
SQL migration rollback contract succeeds; focused Node tests, TypeScript, build/CI and release gates pass before deployment.
